🔥 The fire settles. Viola has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Thabo says quietly "We've been walking past those." Jesse mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
